title: Checkpoints, Distribution & Capstone
description: Study checkpoint contents and safe restoration, distributed data parallel basics, training-failure diagnosis, and capstone: train a reproducible classifier. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Checkpoint contents and safe restoration
lessons.description: Define separate training and inference artifact manifests, then test each in a fresh process.
lessons.conceptOverview: A resumable training checkpoint includes model, optimizer, scheduler, step, data position, and relevant random state. A deployment artifact may need only inference state plus preprocessing metadata. Load artifacts from trusted sources and verify compatibility. Test restoration rather than treating a successful save as evidence of recoverability.

lessons.title: Distributed data parallel basics
lessons.description: Draw a four-rank training step and identify where data sharding, backward, and gradient synchronization occur.
lessons.conceptOverview: Distributed data parallel training replicates a model and synchronizes gradients across ranks. Each rank should receive the intended data shard and participate in compatible collective operations. DDP does not automatically reduce per-rank model-state memory. Global batch size combines local batch, accumulation, and participating ranks.
lessons.whyItMatters: DDP scales work across replicas but generally retains a full model replica per rank.

lessons.title: Training-failure diagnosis
lessons.description: Write a decision tree distinguishing bad inputs, loss-contract errors, gradient problems, and device-memory failures.
lessons.conceptOverview: Localize a failure before applying broad fixes. Non-finite loss can arise from invalid data, unstable arithmetic, or an excessive update; silent non-learning can indicate missing gradients or incorrect labels. Track the first bad batch and compare a minimal baseline. A symptom is not a unique root cause.

lessons.title: Capstone: train a reproducible classifier
lessons.description: Submit code, configuration, baseline comparison, error analysis, and a restoration test for a small classifier.
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a complete small classifier from a Dataset through evaluation and an inference artifact. Keep a held-out split and report a simple baseline. Include shape tests, tiny-batch overfitting, a reproducible configuration, and a checkpoint-resume drill. A successful capstone demonstrates a verified workflow rather than a single favorable accuracy number.
